cards.ex: The old oak tree is still standing, weathering the storm of the century.
cards.exUz: Eski eman daraxti hali ham turibdi, asr bo'roni qiyinchiliklariga bardosh berib.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyat yoki davrni muvaffaqiyatli o'tkazish, bardosh berish.

cards.ex: Deforestation is creating a shrinking habitat for orangutans.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarning kesilishi orangutanlar uchun qisqaruvchi yashash joyini yaratmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar yashashi uchun tobora kamayib borayotgan hudud.

cards.ex: Her smile was a ray of sunshine on a cloudy day.
cards.exUz: Uning tabassumi bulutli kunda quyosh nuridek edi.
cards.uzDef: Qorong'u yoki qiyin vaziyatdagi umid yoki xursandchilik manbai.

cards.ex: The polar bear is on thin ice due to global warming.
cards.exUz: Global isish tufayli oq ayiq xavfli vaziyatda.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki noaniq vaziyatda bo'lish, muammoga yaqin.

cards.ex: The national park gets the lion's share of funding for wildlife protection.
cards.exUz: Milliy bog' yovvoyi tabiatni muhofaza qilish uchun mablag'ning sher ulushini oladi.
cards.uzDef: Eng katta yoki muhim qismi, ko'p qismi.

cards.ex: From the mountain peak, we had a bird's-eye view of the valley.
cards.exUz: Tog' cho'qqisidan vodiyning qush parvozi ko'rinishi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqoridan umumiy ko'rinish, balanddan qarash.

cards.ex: Our donation is just a drop in the bucket compared to what's needed.
cards.exUz: Bizning xayriyaimiz kerak bo'lgan narsaga nisbatan dengizdan bir tomchi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kichik miqdor, ahamiyatsiz qism.

cards.ex: If you think I caused the landslide, you're barking up the wrong tree.
cards.exUz: Agar siz ko'chki sababchisi menman deb o'ylasangiz, xato yo'ldasiz.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yo'lni tanlash, noto'g'ri odamni ayblash.

cards.ex: The company was criticized for clear-cutting a large section of the forest.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'rmonning katta qismini butunlay kesib tashlagani uchun tanqid qilindi.
cards.uzDef: O'rmonni butunlay kesib tashlash, daraxtsiz qilish.

cards.ex: He felt like a fish out of water in the middle of the wildlife convention.
cards.exUz: U yovvoyi tabiat konventsiyasida o'z muhitidan tashqarida bo'lgandek his qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga notanish yoki noqulay vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The environmental report is likely to make waves in the industry.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhit to'g'risidagi hisobot sanoatda bahs-munozaralarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Jamoatchilik orasida norozilik yoki bahs-munozaralarni keltirib chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: Even when the bear approached, he remained as cool as a cucumber.
cards.exUz: Ayiq yaqinlashganda ham, u bodringdek sovuq holda qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Tinch va xotirjam, ayniqsa qiyin vaziyatda.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the wildlife project further.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi hafta yovvoyi tabiat loyihasini muhokama qilish uchun aloqada bo'laylik.
cards.uzDef: Qisqacha aloqa o'rnatish, ma'lumot almashish.

cards.ex: The melting ice caps are causing a snowball effect of environmental problems.
cards.exUz: Muz qalpoqlarining erishi atrof-muhit muammolarining qor uyumi effektiga olib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kichik hodisa asta-sekin katta ta'sirga ega bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The government gave the green light to the new wind farm project.
cards.exUz: Hukumat yangi shamol fermasi loyihasiga yashil chiroq berdi.
cards.uzDef: Ruxsat berish, boshlash uchun imkoniyat berish.

cards.ex: The injured deer is finally out of the woods and recovering well.
cards.exUz: Jarohatlangan kiyik nihoyat xavfdan xalos bo'ldi va yaxshi tuzalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan xalos bo'lish, muammosiz bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company will have to face the music for polluting the river.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya daryoni ifloslantirgani uchun javobgarlikka tortilishi kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Xatti-harakatlar uchun javobgarlikka tortilish, oqibatlariga duch kelish.

cards.ex: Despite his fame, the naturalist was a down-to-earth person.
cards.exUz: Mashhurligiga qaramay, tabiatshunos sodda inson edi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, tabiiy va kamtarin, amaliyotchi.

cards.ex: The conservation group is in deep water after the scandal.
cards.exUz: Muhofaza guruhi janjaldan keyin qiyin ahvolda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavfli vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Exploring the remote jungle was definitely a walk on the wild side.
cards.exUz: Uzoq o'rmonni o'rganish, albatta, vahshiyona hayot edi.
cards.term: a walk on the wild side
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki g'ayrioddiy hayot tarzi.

cards.ex: The small village was destroyed by nature's fury during the tsunami.
cards.exUz: Kichik qishloq sunami paytida tabiat g'azabi tomonidan vayron qilingan.
cards.uzDef: Tabiiy ofatlarning kuchli va vayronkor ta'siri.

cards.ex: The documentary planted a seed of awareness about climate change.
cards.exUz: Hujjatli film iqlim o'zgarishi haqida xabardorlik urug'ini ekdi.
cards.uzDef: G'oya yoki fikrni kiritmoq, boshlamoq.

cards.ex: She became a zoologist like her father; the apple doesn't fall far from the tree.
cards.exUz: U otasidek zoolog bo'ldi; olma daraxtdan uzoqqa tushmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Bolaning xarakteri ota-onasiga o'xshash.

cards.ex: We need to nip this invasive species in the bud before it spreads further.
cards.exUz: Biz ushbu invaziv turni tarqalishidan oldin yo'q qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki xavfni boshlanishida to'xtatmoq, oldini olmoq.

cards.ex: Natural selection favors animals with camouflage in that environment.
cards.exUz: Tabiiy tanlanish o'sha muhitda kamuflyajga ega hayvonlarga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Eng moslashgan organizmlar yashab qolishi jarayoni.

cards.ex: Once the bear left, we signaled that the coast was clear.
cards.exUz: Ayiq ketgach, yo'l ochiqligini bildirdik.
cards.uzDef: Xavf yo'q, harakat qilishga ruxsat.

cards.ex: The kids had a whale of a time at the wildlife park.
cards.exUz: Bolalar yovvoyi tabiat parkida juda yaxshi vaqt o'tkazishdi.
cards.term: have a whale of a time
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi vaqt o'tkazish, zavqlanib dam olish.

cards.ex: Looking for that rare bird turned out to be a wild goose chase.
cards.exUz: O'sha noyob qushni qidirish befoyda izlanish bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi bo'lmaydigan bema'ni izlanish, behuda urinish.

cards.ex: The abandoned farm had gone to seed after years of neglect.
cards.exUz: Tashlandiq ferma yillar davomida qarovsiz qolgandan keyin urug'ga aylanib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Parchalanib ketish, yomonlashish, qarovsiz qolish.

cards.ex: They live out in the sticks, miles from the nearest town.
cards.exUz: Ular eng yaqin shahardan uzoqda, olislarda yashashadi.
cards.uzDef: Shahar tashqarisida, qishloq hududida, olis joyda.
